_about: laneFOESEP v1 (UNPROVEN in Unity): two enemies on Joan at once keep apart from each other and take different sides of her. Read by FoeSep.cs; zones only (needs two fighting enemies, so the single duel and zones-off never read it). enabled false = the v108c behaviour.

separate._about: minimum distance between the two enemy bodies = max(minM, halfWidth(a) + halfWidth(b) + padM). The rear one (farther from Joan; inside yieldMarginM the name order decides) side-steps along the tangent round Joan, at most maxStepM per 60 Hz tick (0.03 = 1.8 m/s), so it never changes his distance to Joan to first order. radialShare 0 = purely tangential; above 0 mixes in straight-away-from-the-peer motion (can push him out of her reach).

spread._about: flank: while the two enemies stand closer than minAngleDeg as seen from Joan, the rear one gets a tangential move input (orbitGain, in moveDir units, fading to 0 over rampDeg) away from the other. inBrain = added in AIBrain.Apply, inChase = bends the chase heading (the gap hand-over is unchanged), aiSide = the AI circle side follows it. rangeM = only while the pair is closer than this.

bodies._about: 0 = the fighter's own DuelFighter.radius (prefab collider radius; Pitborn 0.595, Sobek 0.595 today)
seed = today's radius. lanePITNEW is wider: set the new half width here (metres, centre to the side), no code change
seed = today's radius. laneSOBEKNEW is thin with a big head: the width is the body, put the head extra into padM or the row; no code change
laneMONSTER3 (Grendel): body half width (shoulder plates 0.74 m, hips narrower).
laneMONSTER5 (Humbaba): body half width (shoulders 0.71 m, crest 0.88 m).
laneMONSTER6 (Erlking): body half width (shoulders 0.9 m, antlers 1.0 m).
